invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.18.0 preserves Parts 1–16 and adds Part 17 international e-invoicing through an isolated FiscalDocument and FiscalProviderAdapter boundary: immutable UBL 2.1 invoice/credit-note XML, Peppol BIS Billing identifiers and participant routing, provider-agnostic EDI gateway delivery, encrypted provider credentials, validation evidence, idempotent transmission attempts and authenticated XML export. Kenya eTIMS remains isolated. The standalone responsive Invoicing shell remains module-owned and migrations remain additive.
